ResearchProjectDef.label: basic flesh hive
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks basic flesh hive cultivation, basic fleshbeasts, flesh hoppers, flesh trees, flesh doors, flesh blocks, flesh lamps, and efficient flesh expansion research.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fleshbeast coexistence
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks flesh parasite vats, flesh tendrils, flesh whips, fleshmass lungs, fleshmass stomachs, and flesh adaptation modules.

ResearchProjectDef.label: efficient flesh expansion
ResearchProjectDef.description: Increases global flesh terrain spread speed by 50%.

ResearchProjectDef.label: complex flesh hive
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks whipspike cultivation, medium fleshbeast fusion, flesh sacks, flesh bunkers, flesh recycler pools, flesh primary nests, bone spike spitters, and nerve bundles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: chitin-plated flesh blocks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks chitin-plated flesh blocks and chitin-plated flesh barricades.

ResearchProjectDef.label: efficient nutrition absorption
ResearchProjectDef.description: Increases nutrition gained from corpses, food, and flesh sacks by 50%.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced flesh hive
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks large fleshbeast fusion, advanced mother-beast fusion when the required mother-beast node is available, nerve centers, fleshmass spitters, flesh burst launchers, and parasite expansion packs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: self-repairing flesh
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allows flesh buildings to consume hive nutrition to repair their own hit points over time.

ResearchProjectDef.label: flesh heart control
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reduces global flesh hive activity growth speed by 50%.
